title: Watch Arnold Schwarzenegger in Prime’s new holiday ad
summary: “The Man with the Bag” star goes undercover as Santa Claus in New York City in Prime’s 2026 holiday ad, “Santa Schwarzenegger.”
body_markdown:
Arnold Schwarzenegger is suiting up as Santa Claus in Amazon’s 2026 holiday ad, Santa Schwarzenegger. The spot follows Schwarzenegger as he orders a Santa suit on Amazon,


[delivered fast with Prime](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-benefits) , and goes undercover on the streets of New York City—blending into the holiday crowds, catching a game at a local bar, helping families celebrate, and rediscovering the simple joys of the season.


[Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026: a first look at Amazon’s best deals](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-black-friday-cyber-monday-deals-2026)


Millions of deals across electronics, beauty, fashion, toys, and more drop November 19 through November 30, with new daily themed deals and double drops on Black Friday and Cyber Monday.


“When the Prime team shared this idea, it was the fastest ‘yes,’” Schwarzenegger said. “I’ve played a lot of iconic characters, but Santa might be the most iconic.”


You can also watch Schwarzenegger as Santa in Prime Video’s upcoming holiday film


[The Man with the Bag](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/the-man-with-the-bag-arnold-schwarzenegger-christmas-movie-prime-video) , starring alongside Alan Ritchson and Awkwafina, premiering globally on December 2.
